micro.notes: MSVC Release, one warmup, rotated order with three backends or alternating with two. Same production hasher, fixed shuffled input, one insertion and three hit passes. Destruction excluded from timings. Adapters retain insertion-order keys as required by AnalysisIndex consumers. Map plus ordered-vector allocation byte counts are allocator requests, not process RSS or allocator overhead. Input keys excluded. Custom memory is vector capacity; reserve prevents growth.

method: Serial Release runs. Microbenchmark warms all paths and rotates/alternates order. Real-model stage batches use three runs in each fresh process, then reverse backend order; load/render excluded. Every trailing detector count is retained and validated across all runs/backends. No concurrent builds or tests.
